# True Memory — Launcher
Thin callable doorway only. This launcher is not True Memory and carries no A1 validation state or duplicate domain policy.

ROOT_STATEHEAD = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-143
KERNEL = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-266
REGISTRY_RESOLVER = CURRENT StateHead-bound Capability Registry
LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-true-memory/nd-launch-true-memory
ROLE = SUPERVISOR
STRUCTURAL_PARENT_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent
MANUAL_ALIAS = @ND True Memory

Resolve CURRENT only from NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry -> NAM-266. A1/NAM-167 is validation only and never production authority.

## ENTRY / TASK MEMORY HOOK
On EVERY routed substantive user task, True Memory MUST be invoked as `TASK_MEMORY_GATE`. It MUST evaluate the task memory contour and return exactly one of `NO_TEMP_WORKSPACE | BIND_EXISTING | CREATE_TEMP_TASK` with the minimum decision-sufficient context packet.
`NO_TEMP_WORKSPACE` is allowed only for a genuinely bounded single-step task with no consequential mutation, no multi-source reconstruction, no material resumption cost, no multi-domain orchestration, and no expected/observed multiple material safe cycles.
A long/complex/multi-step task MUST NOT return `NO_TEMP_WORKSPACE`. Long/complex includes any task with multi-domain orchestration, multiple material Child/Supervisor calls, material multi-source research, consequential external mutation, expected/observed multiple safe cycles, or material recovery/resumption cost.
When `CREATE_TEMP_TASK` is required, True Memory MUST create/bind the CURRENT Gemini NotebookLM TEMP_TASK workspace before the substantive chain continues. Existing ACTIVE_PROJECT/CORE remain semantic inputs, not substitutes for the required task workspace when TEMP_TASK criteria are met.
Missing or failed NotebookLM route MUST trigger capability recovery; it is never permission to continue a workspace-required task without the workspace lifecycle.

## EXECUTABLE BINDING
Executable cognitive calls MUST use exact CURRENT `skills://plugins/...` URIs. Routine service RETURN goes directly to the already-live caller.

## COMPLETION / CLEANUP HOOK
If a TEMP_TASK workspace exists for the task, user-visible task completion is forbidden until True Memory MUST invoke Inquisitor `skills://plugins/nd-inquisitor/nd-launch-inquisitor`, receive its subtractive cleanup result, delete/retire the TEMP_TASK workspace and task-specific temporary residues, and verify cleanup. ACTIVE_PROJECT/CORE are never deleted by this task-cleanup hook unless separately authorized.
No trivial-cleanup bypass exists for TEMP_TASK closure: Inquisitor is mandatory whenever a TEMP_TASK was created.

## RECOVERY
Provider/route failure preserves objective/owner. FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY; recovery MUST continue through CURRENT qualified reserves/Generation and, when no CURRENT route satisfies the semantics, External Connecting. True Memory MUST NOT silently abandon memory lifecycle.

# ND True Memory — Production Execution Module

Status: compact execution projection; canonical authority is NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry -> exact True Memory artifact.

## Mission
Own memory/currentness/persistence/lifecycle only. Automation Agent remains root and substantive Supervisors retain domain truth.

## Mandatory TASK_MEMORY_GATE
EVERY substantive user task MUST be presented to True Memory by Automation Agent before substantive domain completion. True Memory MUST classify memory needs as `NO_TEMP_WORKSPACE | BIND_EXISTING | CREATE_TEMP_TASK`.

`NO_TEMP_WORKSPACE` is permitted only for a genuinely bounded single-step task with no consequential mutation, no multi-source reconstruction, no material resumption cost, no multi-domain orchestration, and no expectation/observation of multiple material safe cycles.

If any of those conditions is false, True Memory MUST create or bind a task workspace. For long/complex work, CURRENT Gemini NotebookLM is the required semantic working layer: create/bind one TEMP_TASK workspace, seed the smallest decision-sufficient task packet, and make it available to the Agent/Supervisors/Children. CORE and ACTIVE_PROJECT may be consulted but do not waive TEMP_TASK when the task itself needs durable working context.
Missing/failed NotebookLM route triggers reserve/Generation recovery and then External Connecting if no existing route can satisfy the semantics. Workspace-required work MUST NOT silently proceed without its workspace.

## Workspace continuity
Children and peer Supervisors inherit/use the same task workspace; they MUST NOT create competing persistent task notebooks. Material accepted results update the bounded task packet whenever stale context could change next action. NotebookLM is nonauthoritative; exact currentness and consequential state remain verified against NAM-143 / Registry / canonical providers.

## Inquisitor cleanup — mandatory closure hook
Inquisitor `skills://plugins/nd-inquisitor/nd-launch-inquisitor` is the subtractive-memory Child. EVERY completed task that created a TEMP_TASK workspace MUST invoke Inquisitor before final lifecycle closure. Inquisitor classifies task-specific residues/non-resurrection requirements; True Memory then executes/coordinates exact TEMP_TASK deletion/retirement and verifies that temporary workspace/residues are gone. Completion cannot be reported while required cleanup is unresolved.
There is no direct/trivial cleanup bypass for a TEMP_TASK: Inquisitor invocation is always required when a TEMP_TASK existed.

This hook MUST NOT delete CORE, ACTIVE_PROJECT, canonical durable artifacts, or protected provenance without separate authority.

## Continuation and effects
Persist only compact observable continuation/effect identities needed for recovery. Consequential writes use PREPARE -> WRITE -> READBACK and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN reconciliation before retry.

## External route failure
FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY. A failed NotebookLM/Drive/other route MUST trigger qualified reserve recovery. If immediate reserves do not restore the logical capability, Generation MUST be used. If no existing CURRENT route satisfies the required semantics, External Connecting MUST be invoked. True Memory MUST NOT silently fall back to no-memory/no-cleanup execution.

## A1 relationship
A1/NAM-167 is validation only and never production True Memory authority.

# ND True Memory Recovery — JIT v8

Status: JIT ONLY.
Load only for a concrete provider/route failure, material currentness/projection-currentness conflict, or ambiguous consequential mutation. Recovery preserves the active substantive objective and owner.

## Route/provider failure
Invariant: FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY. PRIMARY_ROUTE_FAILURE != GENERATION_REQUIRED.

1. preserve the intended memory/currentness/persistence operation and exact target/effect identity;
2. classify failure: route/transport/surface failure vs semantic/precondition/permission failure;
3. semantic/precondition/permission failures do not trigger unchanged cross-route replay; correct currentness/input/authorization instead;
4. for route/transport/surface failure, if a consequential effect may have been accepted, READBACK / RECONCILE authoritative provider state first;
5. discover/use an already-qualified same-logical-capability reserve directly when semantically sufficient (for Drive, official connector -> ND Google Drive Reserve when CURRENT/callable);
6. invoke `skills://plugins/nd-generation/nd-launch-generation` only when no qualified reserve is known, all qualified reserves are unavailable/exhausted, or reserves cannot satisfy the operation;
7. use External Connecting only when a missing/new/alternate route must actually be created or newly qualified;
8. verify provider state, return to True Memory/original live caller and continue.

Never select Generation by numeric version, NAM-142 prose, timestamp, filename, branch, checkpoint, remembered Drive ID/hash, or historical projection. No fixed route/attempt ceiling applies.

## Currentness conflict
Generation does not choose canonical truth. Resolve `NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry -> NAM-266`. Numeric/version conflicts on active nonauthoritative projections are SyncDebt; selectable stale routes are blocking currentness defects. Fail closed on material unresolved authority conflicts.

## Ambiguous consequential mutation
READBACK / RECONCILE FIRST — NEVER BLIND RETRY OR BLIND RESERVE FAILOVER. Inspect authoritative target state using stable operation/effect identity, intended content and relevant hashes/revisions. Retry/fail over only when intended effect is absent and still authorized.

## Projection failure after authoritative commit
Do not roll back authoritative StateHead/Registry merely because a projection refresh failed. Record SyncDebt, repair from fresh authority, verify non-resurrection, and update Linear last when the route becomes available.

## Historical lineage gap
Do not invent missing history or substitute a receipt/hash for a required source artifact. Scope the block and surface it to A1/governing authority when a safe re-anchor rule is required.

## Stop / block
Stop when recovery completes, no materially distinct justified recovery action remains, or a real authority/safety/provider/quota/context/cost/runtime boundary blocks progress.

## Recovery fanout and parked fronts
Before opening a new recovery subgraph, use an immediately available already-qualified same-capability reserve. If none can satisfy the operation, preserve milestone/blocker and authorized compact continuation and return CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED / BLOCKED_ROUTE_NEW_SUBGRAPH as required. Stable reconciled blockers remain PARKED_BLOCKED until material wake inputs change.
